UK Schools Ban Deep-Fried Food, Reduce Desserts in New Rules

Schools in the United Kingdom are implementing new regulations that ban deep-fried foods and reduce the availability of sugary desserts in school dinners. These changes are part of a broader overhaul aimed at improving the health standards of meals provided to students. The new rules focus on healthier preparation methods and limiting sugar content.
